name: The Shady Pig
priceRange: Rp 130.000 – Rp 500.000 per person (cocktails + bar bites) and minimum spend from ~Rp 8.000.000 for VIP table after 23:00
description: a 1920s-themed speakeasy bar in Canggu, Bali, known for its experimental cocktails and mobster syndicate-inspired atmosphere. It offers a menu of refined bites and canapés to accompany its signature and classic drinks.
